findings.message:
Require a separator after the close keyword

The `\s*` around the optional colon permits no separator at all, so inputs such as `Fixes#123` or `Fixesowner/repo#123` lose `Fixes` even though the keyword is not delimited from the reference. This violates the function's promise to preserve unrelated body text; require whitespace or a valid colon-delimited form.

src/github/text.ts:12-12

summary: The sanitizer can remove text from references that are not valid close-keyword forms.
